== English Endor comparison ==
Decipher replaces the single front sentence to specify Reserve Deck. Original front omits the words. The later E-marked full front, the 2013/2017 PC slips, and PC Appendix A through 2022 all retain the change. The 2023 Appendix A p. 125 instead repeats the Original front text. Current PC full face and pinned data retain Reserve Deck and no reversion announcement surfaced. Record the source conflict without adding a third state. The back has no identified Errata change.
